misconfig_patterns: Default deployment exposes :9090 with no auth; full read access to metric values + targets
/api/v1/targets reveals scrape topology — internal hostnames + scrape config
/api/v1/status/config returns the full prometheus.yml contents — includes remote_write URLs, basic_auth credentials in static configs if present, AlertManager URLs
/api/v1/status/flags exposes the server's command-line including --web.config.file (if any) and --storage.tsdb.path
/api/v1/query allows arbitrary PromQL — full metric value exfiltration
/api/v1/admin/tsdb/delete_series and /snapshot accept POSTs (gated by --web.enable-admin-api default false; but operators who flip the flag forget)
/debug/pprof/ exposed by default; --web.config.file basic_auth scope does NOT cover pprof on older versions (same class as VictoriaMetrics issue #3060)

active_probe.false_positive_check: CONJUNCTIVE: response body must be valid JSON with data.version AND data.goVersion AND data.revision populated. VictoriaMetrics returns {"status":"success","data":{}} — an EMPTY data object (no version, no goVersion) on this exact path; that empty-data shape is the cleanest VM-vs-Prometheus anti-match (sharper than the older 'fake 2.24.0' framing — VM does not emit a fake version, it emits nothing). ANTI-MATCH for the rest of the family: Thanos answers /api/v1/stores (Prometheus 404s it); Mimir/Cortex serve query under /prometheus/* or reject bare query with 'no org id' (Prometheus serves /api/v1/* at root with no tenant gate). So Prometheus = goVersion-present buildinfo AND /api/v1/stores 404 AND no 'no org id' tenant error AND /graph SPA at root.

deployment_tells: /graph SPA at root identifies Prometheus uniquely
/api/v1/status/buildinfo returns JSON with 'goVersion' field (distinguishes from VM Prometheus-API-compat)
/metrics endpoint exposes prometheus_* internal metrics (prometheus_target_scrapes_*, prometheus_engine_query_duration_seconds)
pivot_paths: GET /api/v1/targets -> scrape configuration -> internal hostnames + RFC1918 endpoints (Insight #88 generalization)
GET /api/v1/status/config -> full prometheus.yml -> remote_write URLs + AlertManager URLs + embedded credentials
GET /api/v1/label/__name__/values -> full metric-name catalog -> operator stack inference
GET /api/v1/query?query=up -> currently-monitored target inventory with status
vulnerabilities: CVE-2019-3826: Stored XSS in /graph SPA pre-2.7.1 (legacy; long patched)
Design choice (NOT a CVE): no authentication by default; documented in upstream docs as operator responsibility
Same class as VictoriaMetrics issue #3060: --web.config.file basic_auth may not cover /debug/pprof/ on older versions
auth_default_thesis: AUTH-OFF-DEFAULT confirmed. Prometheus ships with --web.config.file empty by default. Operators must enable web.yml with TLS/basic auth, or run behind a reverse proxy. Direct analog to VictoriaMetrics. Falsifier hypothesis: if Prometheus unauth rate matches VM (~93.5%), the auth-off-default thesis generalizes to Q4 Topology Mirror tier. If Prometheus comes back at <50% unauth, VM is anomalous and operators DO harden Prometheus specifically.
